z-m-14-14.thinking.2: Kunyora zvakare tsananguro kuti ienderane nemuverengi
z-m-14-14.title: Kunyora patsva mirayiridzo yeribhoni yokusunga bhokisi rechipo
z-m-14-14.topic: Hurefu hwecuboid nehurefu hweribhoni (kunyora patsva mirayiridzo)
z-m-14-14.goal: Dzidza kutsvaga hurefu nokutevera nzira yaunotora ribhoni chaizvo, uye unyore patsva mirayiridzo isina kururama kuva yakarurama.
z-m-14-14.material: Bhokisi rechipo icuboid ine upamhi hwe 20 cm, hurefu hwe 15 cm, nokukwirira kwe 10 cm. Unoda kusunga bhokisi iri neribhoni muchimiro chemuchinjikwa. Ribhoni inopindirana pakati pechiso chepamusoro chebhokisi nemakona akarurama, inoenda nepasi nenzira yakananga ichitevera zviso zvomativi, uye inopindiranazve pakati pechiso chepasi. Rwuvhoko rumwe runotenderera bhokisi kamwe munzira yeupamhi uye rumwe runotenderera kamwe munzira yehurefu. Usafunga nezvokukora kweribhoni, uye shandisa 25 cm yakawedzerwa kuhuru nokugadzira bhawu.
z-m-14-14.thinking.1: Kugadzira iwe pachako hukuru hunosangana nemamiriro
z-m-14-14.prereq.0: Upamhi, hurefu, kukwirira, nomugariro wezviso zvecuboid (Gredhi 4-5)
z-m-14-14.s.s1.prompt: Soyoung akawana hurefu hweribhoni seizvi. Sarudza mutsetse mumwe wakanganisa.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.hint.0: Tevera nomunwe wako kuti rwuvhoko rumwe rweribhoni runopfuura pazviso zvipi zvebhokisi nokurongeka.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.hint.1: Muhurefu ihwohwo, verenga kuti upamhi, hurefu, nokukwirira zvinosanganisirwa kangani.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.line.0: Funga kuti ribhoni inosungirira kutevera makona ebhokisi. Cuboid ine makona 12.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.line.1: Pane makona eupamhi 4, makona ehurefu 4, nemakona okukwirira 4, saka 4×(20+15+10)=180 cm.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.line.2: Kuwedzera 25 cm yehuru nebhawu kunopa 180+25=205 cm inodikanwa.
z-m-14-14.s.s1.explain: Zvakanganisa kubva pamutsetse 1. Ribhoni yakasungwa muchimiro chemuchinjikwa haitevedzi makona; inopfuura nepakati pechiso chepamusoro nechepasi. Saka 180 cm yomutsetse 2 ne 205 cm yomutsetse 3 dzakanganisawo. Kutenderera kumwe munzira yeupamhi i 20+10+20+10=60 cm, kutenderera kumwe munzira yehurefu i 15+10+15+10=50 cm, saka 60+50+25=135 cm yakarurama.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.prompt: Chitoro cheribhoni chine chidimbu chimwe chete cheribhoni chakasara, chine hurefu hwe 120 cm. Gadzira hukuru hutatu hwakasiyana hwebhokisi recuboid rinogona kusungwa nechidimbu chimwe cheribhoni ichi nenzira imwe chete sepamusoro (chimiro chemuchinjikwa, huru we 25 cm) uye rine vhoriyumu ye 1500 cm³ kana kupfuura. (upamhi a ≥ hurefu b ≥ kukwirira h, zvose nhamba dzechisikigo dze 5 kana kupfuura, chikamu cm)
z-m-14-14.s.s2.hint.0: Uchishandisa nzira yawakawana pamusoro, isa upamhi, hurefu, nokukwirira uye utanga waverenga kuti ribhoni inodikanwa yakadini.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.hint.1: Ramba uchichengeta ribhoni isingapfuuri 120 cm uchichinja upamhi, hurefu, nokukwirira, uye uenzanise mavhoriyumu.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.fail.c1: Inofanira kuva upamhi ≥ hurefu ≥ kukwirira uye kukwirira kunofanira kuva 5 kana kupfuura.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.fail.c3: Ribhoni (kutenderera kumwe munzira yeupamhi + kutenderera kumwe munzira yehurefu + huru we 25 cm) inopfuura 120 cm.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.fail.c4: Vhoriyumu iri pasi pe 1500 cm³. Edza kuita bhokisi guru kana kuchinja chimiro charo.
z-m-14-14.s.s2.explain: Hurefu hweribhoni i (upamhi×2+kukwirira×2)+(hurefu×2+kukwirira×2)+25 = upamhi×2+hurefu×2+kukwirira×4+25. Kuti ive 120 cm kana shoma, upamhi×2+hurefu×2+kukwirira×4 inofanira kuva 95 kana shoma. Semuenzaniso, 15×15×8 inoda ribhoni ye 117 cm uye ine vhoriyumu ye 1800 cm³. 20×12×6 inoda ribhoni ye 113 cm asi vhoriyumu yayo i 1440 cm³, saka haishande.
z-m-14-14.s.s3.prompt: Nyora patsva tsananguro yaSoyoung semirayiridzo yokupfeka chipo ichaverengwa neshamwari dzamakirasi. Kuti inogona kushandiswa kunyange hukuru hwebhokisi huchichinja, taura kuti ribhoni inoenda papi, kuti upamhi, hurefu, nokukwirira zvinoverengwa kangani, uye kuti hurefu hwakashandiswa kuhuru hunobatwa sei.
z-m-14-14.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora, nokurongeka, mazita ezviso zvinopfuurwa neribhoni panguva imwe yokutenderera.
z-m-14-14.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora kutenderera kumwe munzira yeupamhi nokutenderera kumwe munzira yehurefu semafomula akasiyana, wobva wavabatanidza.
z-m-14-14.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shamwari inoverenga mirayiridzo iyi chete inogona kuverenga hurefu hweribhoni yebhokisi rehukuru hwakasiyanawo here?
z-m-14-14.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakanyora here chaizvo kuti upamhi, hurefu, nokukwirira zvinoverengwa kangani?
z-m-14-14.s.s3.model.0: Ribhoni haitevedzi makona; inopfuura nepakati pechiso chepamusoro nepakati pechiso chepasi. Rimwe kutenderera rinopfuura upamhi hwechiso chepamusoro, kukwirira kwechiso chepadivi, upamhi hwechiso chepasi, nokukwirira kwechiso chepadivi chakatarisana, saka i (upamhi×2+kukwirira×2). Rimwe kutenderera i (hurefu×2+kukwirira×2). Wedzera kutenderera kuviri uye wedzera hurefu hwehuru. Pabhokisi iri i 60+50+25=135 cm.
z-m-14-14.s.s3.model.1: Ribhoni inoenda muchimiro chemuchinjikwa nepakati pezviso zvepamusoro nezvepasi zvebhokisi, kwete ichitevera makona. Kutenderera kumwe munzira yeupamhi kunoverenga upamhi ka 2 nokukwirira ka 2, uye kutenderera kumwe munzira yehurefu kunoverenga hurefu ka 2 nokukwirira ka 2, saka pamwe chete i upamhi×2+hurefu×2+kukwirira×4. Wobva wawedzera hurefu hwehuru.

z-m-14-07.title: 40% ne25%: kirasi ipi ine nhengo dzakawanda?
z-m-14-07.topic: Ratio nehuwandu chaihwo: kana huwandu hwekutanga hwakasiyana
z-m-14-07.goal: Ratidza nemienzaniso yawakagadzira iwe pachako kuti saizi yeratio nehuwandu chaihwo hwevanhu zvinogona kuenzaniswa zvakasiyana kana huwandu hwekutanga (huwandu hwose hwevanhu) hwakasiyana, uye tsvaga kuti nei usingafaniri kufungidzira nekukosha kwepakati kana uchibatanidza ma ratios emakirasi maviri.
z-m-14-07.material: Mu reading club yepashure pechikoro, 40% yevadzidzi veKirasi 3 ne25% yevadzidzi veKirasi 5 vakapinda. Hausati waziva huwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mumakirasi maviri. Huwandu hwevadzidzi mukirasi ndi15 kana kupfuura uye 50 kana pasi, uye huwandu hwevadzidzi vakapinda ndi natural number (munhu haagoni kucheka nehafu).

z-m-14-07.s.s1.prompt: Kirasi ipi ine vadzidzi vakawanda vakapinda?
z-m-14-07.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza huwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mumakirasi maviri imwe neimwe uye utsvage huwandu hwevadzidzi vakapinda.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.hint.1: Edza kusarudza huwandu hwevadzidzi hwakasiyana kuKirasi 3 neKirasi 5 uye uone kana kuti ndeipi ine nhengo dzakawanda kunochinja.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.o.a: Hatigoni kusarudza kana tisingazivi huwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mumakirasi maviri.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.r.a: Wakatonga kuti ratio ichikamu chechose, saka kuti uenzanise huwandu hwevadzidzi vakapinda, unoda huwandu hwose hwevadzidzi.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.o.b: Kirasi 3 ine vakawanda. Nekuti 40% yakakura kupfuura 25%.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.r.b: Wakaenzanisa saizi dzema ratios chete. Hauna kutarisa kana huwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mumakirasi maviri hwakafanana.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.o.c: Kirasi 5 ine vakawanda. Nekuti kirasi ine ratio yakaderera ine vadzidzi vakawanda.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.r.c: Wakafungidzira zvakapesana usina kutarisa umboo. Edza kirasi ine vadzidzi vashoma zvakare.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.o.d: Kirasi 3 inowanzo kuva neyakawanda, asi hazvina chokwadi. Nekuti 40% yakakura zvikuru.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.r.d: Wakafunga kuti divi rine ratio hombe rinogona kuva nezvakawanda. Edza mienzaniso yekirasi ine vadzidzi vashoma nekirasi ine vadzidzi vakawanda kutarisa kana zvakadaro chaizvo.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.o.e: Dzakafanana. Nekuti mumakirasi ose maviri vamwe vadzidzi chete ndivo vakapinda.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.r.e: Tarisa kana chokwadi chekuti ndi "vamwe" chiri chikonzero chekuti huwandu hwevadzidzi vakapinda hwakafanana.
z-m-14-07.s.s1.explain: Ratio ichikamu chechose, saka kuti uenzanise huwandu hwevadzidzi vakapinda, unofanira kuziva huwandu hwose hwevadzidzi mumakirasi maviri. Semuenzaniso, kana Kirasi 3 ine vadzidzi 20, ndi8, uye kana Kirasi 5 ine vadzidzi 40, ndi10, saka Kirasi 5 inogona kuva neyakawanda.
z-m-14-07.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira nyaya 3 umo vadzidzi vakawanda veKirasi 5 vakapinda kupfuura veKirasi 3. Kirasi 3 ine vadzidzi x uye Kirasi 5 ine vadzidzi y. (Huwandu hwevadzidzi vakapinda ndi natural number.)

z-m-14-07.s.s2.ok.c1: Makirasi ose maviri ane vadzidzi 15 kana kupfuura uye 50 kana pasi.
z-m-14-07.s.s2.fail.c1: Huwandu hwevadzidzi mukirasi hunofanira kuva 15 kana kupfuura uye 50 kana pasi.
z-m-14-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Kuti huwandu hwevadzidzi vakapinda huve natural number, Kirasi 3 inofanira kuva multiple ye5 uye Kirasi 5 inofanira kuva multiple ye4.

z-m-14-11.title: Kana ukatarisa kubva pamusoro idenderedzwa. Inogona kunge ichiita chimiro chipi?
z-m-14-11.topic: Masirinda, makoni, nemabhora: zvimiro zvazvo zvichienderana nerutivi rwaunotarisa
z-m-14-11.goal: Nzwisisa kuti chimiro chinoonekwa kubva kurutivi rumwe chingasarudze chimiro chakasimba, sarudza ruzivo rwunodiwa kusarudza chimiro sechimwe chete, uye ugadzire mubvunzo unosiyanisa.
z-m-14-11.material: Chimiro chakasimba chiri padesiki. Chimiro ichi chimwe chesirinda, koni, kana bhora. z-m-14-01.title: Kuenda pa60 km paawa ndokudzoka pa40 km paawa: avhareji yerwendo rwekuenda nekudzoka i?

z-m-14-01.material: Mhuri yaMina yakaenda nokudzoka kumba kwaambuya nemota panzira imwe chete. Pakuenda vakafambisa nokumhanya kwe 60 km paawa (kumhanya kwokufamba 60 km paawa imwe) kubva kutanga kusvika kupera, uye pakudzoka vakafambisa ne 40 km paawa kubva kutanga kusvika kupera, vasina kuzorora pakati. Chinhambwe chokuenda nechokudzoka chakafanana. Pano, "kumhanya kweavhareji kwokuenda nokudzoka" ndiko kumhanya paawa kwaungaita kana ukafambisa nzira yose yokuenda nokudzoka nokumhanya kwakafanana nguva dzose. Hauna kuziva kuti chinhambwe chiri ma km mangani.

z-m-14-10.title: Kana ukanamatidza mabhokisi maviri, zvinoitika sei kunzvimbo yepamusoro?
z-m-14-10.topic: Nzvimbo yepamusoro yechimiro chakagadzirwa nekubatanidza zvimiro
z-m-14-10.goal: Tsvaga kukanganisa mukugadzirisa "wedzera chete nzvimbo dzepamusoro dzeimwe neimwe" pakutsvaga nzvimbo yepamusoro yechimiro chakagadzirwa nekubatanidza ma cuboids maviri, uye utonge mamiriro apo nzvimbo yekubatanidza inokanganisa nzvimbo yepamusoro.
z-m-14-10.material: Isa cuboid diki B (4 cm muhupamhi, 6 cm muhurefu, 3 cm kukwirira) pachiso chepamusoro che cuboid hombe A (10 cm muhupamhi, 6 cm muhurefu, 4 cm kukwirira) uye uvanamatidze kuita chimiro chimwe. Pasi pese pe B (4 cm muhupamhi, 6 cm muhurefu) pakabata chiso chepamusoro che A, uye hurefu hwe B hwe 6 cm hwakafanana nehurefu hwe A hwe 6 cm, saka zviso zvekumberi nezvekumashure zvinoenderana. Unoda kupenda chiso chese chinoonekwa kunze kwechimiro ichi (kusanganisira chiso chepasi). "Nzvimbo yepamusoro" i pundutso yenzvimbo dzezviso zvese zvinoonekwa kunze.
z-m-14-10.thinking.1: Kutonga kana nzira (nzvimbo) yekubatanidza ichichinja mhedzisiro
z-m-14-10.thinking.2: Kufunga kuti mhedziso inochinja sei kana mamiriro achichinja

z-m-14-10.s.s1.prompt: Seohyeon akawana nzvimbo yepamusoro seizvi. Sarudza mutsetse mumwe usina kururama.

z-m-14-10.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana nzvimbo yezviso zvisingaonekwi yakasanganisirwa mu 248 ne 108 imwe neimwe.
z-m-14-10.s.s1.line.2: Nzvimbo yepamusoro yechimiro chakabatanidzwa i nzvimbo dzepamusoro dze A ne B dzakawedzerwa pamwe chete: 248+108=356 cm².
z-m-14-10.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3 hauna kururama. Chikamu apo chiso chepamusoro che A nechiso chepasi che B zvinobatana (4×6=24 cm²) hachionekwi kunze mushure mekubatanidza. Asi 248 inosanganisira chiso chepamusoro che A che 24 cm², uye 108 inosanganisira chiso chepasi che B che 24 cm², saka zvikamu zviviri zvakavanzika hazvina kubviswa. 356−24−24=308 cm² i yakarurama, uye 356 cm² iri mumutsetse wekupedzisira i yakaipa semhedzisiro.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.prompt: B inogona kunamatidzwa kupi nekupi chero pasi pese pe B pakabata mukati mechiso chepamusoro che A. Mingi akanamatidza B kumucheto weruboshwe wechiso chepamusoro che A, uye Hayun akaitanamatidza padyo nepakati (muzvose, hurefu hwe B hwakafanana nehurefu hwe A). Nzvimbo dzepamusoro dzechimiro chimwe nechimwe dzinoenzanisa sei?
z-m-14-10.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga nzvimbo yekubatana kwechimiro chimwe nechimwe chemaviri.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kana, kana nzvimbo inobatana yakafanana, nzvimbo yakavanzika yakafananawo.

z-m-14-10.s.s2.r.a: Wakaita zviso zvinoita sezvinoenderera panzvimbo imwe chete sezvakafanana nezviso zvakavanzika. Kunyange zvichienderana, nzvimbo yakabuda haidzikiri.

z-m-14-10.s.s2.r.b: Wakaita mipendero yakawanda sezvakafanana nenzvimbo yepamusoro yakawanda. Ishande nenzvimbo dzezviso.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.o.c: Haugone kuenzanisa zvimiro zvakasimba zviviri kusvikira wayera chaizvo nzvimbo yekubatanidza.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.r.c: Shanda kuti chaunoda kusarudza nzvimbo yepamusoro kukosha chaiko kwenzvimbo kana nzvimbo inobatana.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.o.d: Nzvimbo dzepamusoro dzezvimiro zvakasimba zviviri dzakafanana. Nokuti nzvimbo inobatana yakafanana kunyange ichibatanidzwa kupi.
z-m-14-10.s.s2.r.d: Wakaenzanisa nekushanda kuti nzvimbo yezviso zvakavanzika yakafanana here kunyange kana nzvimbo yakasiyana.

z-m-14-09.topic: Kufungidzira nzvimbo yedenderedzwa (kuverenga masikweya e grid)
z-m-14-09.goal: Uchishandisa masikweya ari mukati chaimo medenderedzwa pa grid nemasikweya aridzivira zvishoma, taura range iri nzvimbo yedenderedzwa, uye utarise fungidziro yako nekuona kuti range inochinja sei kana masikweya achiitwa madiki.
z-m-14-09.material: Denderedzwa rine radius ye 5 cm rakadhonzwa pamapepa e grid apo sikweya imwe neimwe i 1 cm muhupamhi uye 1 cm muhurefu (nzvimbo 1 cm²). Pakati pedenderedzwa pari pavertex imwe ye grid. Pane masikweya 60 ari mukati chaimo medenderedzwa, uye kusanganisira masikweya anodarikwa nemutsetse wedenderedzwa, pane masikweya 88 ese ari zvishoma kana kupfuura mukati medenderedzwa. Fungidzira kuti hausati wadzidza maitiro ekuwana nzvimbo yedenderedzwa.
z-m-14-09.thinking.1: Kugadzira fungidziro dzakati wandei dzinogutsa mamiriro
z-m-14-09.prereq.0: Zvinoreva nzvimbo nekuverenga masikweya e grid e 1 cm² (padanho regiredhi re3-4)
z-m-14-09.prereq.1: Zvikamu zvedenderedzwa (radius, diameter) nezvinoreva pi (padanho regiredhi re6, semester yekutanga)
z-m-14-09.s.s1.prompt: Ndezvipi zvaunogona kutaura nezvenzvimbo yedenderedzwa kubva pamhedzisiro yekuverenga grid iyi?
z-m-14-09.s.s1.hint.0: Dhonza sikweya nesikweya uye ufunge kuti masikweya ari mukati chaimo nemasikweya akafukidzwa zvishoma anoenderana sei nenzvimbo yedenderedzwa.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga kana nzvimbo yedenderedzwa ingaita diki kupfuura 60 uye kana ingaita hombe kupfuura 88.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.o.a: Nzvimbo yedenderedzwa i 60 cm². Masikweya ari mukati chaimo chete ndiwo ari mudenderedzwa.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.r.a: Wakasiya kuti masikweya anodarikwa nemutsetse wedenderedzwa ane chikamu chiri mukati medenderedzwa zvakare.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.o.b: Nzvimbo yedenderedzwa i 88 cm². Masikweya anodarikwa nemutsetse ese i denderedzwa.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.r.b: Hauna kufunga kuti masikweya anodarikwa nemutsetse ari mukati medenderedzwa zvishoma chete.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.o.c: Nzvimbo yedenderedzwa i hombe kupfuura 60 cm² uye i diki kupfuura 88 cm².
z-m-14-09.s.s1.r.c: Wakashandisa nzvimbo yemasikweya ari mukati chaimo nenzvimbo yemasikweya ari zvishoma kana kupfuura mukati kutaura range.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.o.d: Nzvimbo yedenderedzwa i 74 cm² chaizvo. Izvi nekuti i pakati pe 60 ne 88.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.r.d: Wakasimbisa kuti pakati perange i mutengo chaiwo. Hapana nzira yekuziva kana masikweya akafukidzwa zvishoma ari hafu mukati.
z-m-14-09.s.s1.explain: Denderedzwa i hombe kupfuura masikweya 60 ari mukati chaimo, uye i diki kupfuura masikweya 88 ari zvishoma kana kupfuura mukati. Saka tinogona kutaura kuti i hombe kupfuura 60 cm² uye i diki kupfuura 88 cm².
z-m-14-09.s.s2.prompt: Nyora mitengo mitatu yakasiyana (mu cm²) yaunofunga kuti i fungidziro dzine musoro dzenzvimbo yedenderedzwa iri. (Dzinyore senhamba dzakazara.)
z-m-14-09.s.s2.hint.0: Funga nhamba mbarwa dzakakura kupfuura 60 uye dzidiki kupfuura 88.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti pamasikweya 28 akafukidzwa zvishoma (88−60), anenge mangani ari mukati pakati pese, uye usarudze fungidziro.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.ok.c1: I hombe kupfuura 60 uye i diki kupfuura 88.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.fail.c1: Nzvimbo yedenderedzwa inofanira kuva hombe kupfuura 60 cm² uye diki kupfuura 88 cm².
z-m-14-09.s.s2.explain: Nhamba yakazara ipi neipi yakakura kupfuura 60 cm² uye diki kupfuura 88 cm² i fungidziro iri mukati merange. Semuenzaniso, 70, 74, 78, ne 80 zvose zvakanaka. Mutengo upi unovimbika zvikuru unoenderana nekuti zvakawanda sei zvemasikweya akafukidzwa zvishoma zviri mukati.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.prompt: Pafungidziro mitatu yawangoinyora, sarudza yaunofunga kuti inovimbika zvikuru, uye unyore kuti nei wakafunga kudaro.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tanga wanyora kuti ichava chii kana masikweya ese 28 akafukidzwa zvishoma aiva mukati medenderedzwa uye kuti ichava chii kana pasina aiva mukati.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.hint.1: Mumutsara mumwe, nyora kuti mutengo wawakasarudza uri kupi pakati pezvaya.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Mutengo wandakasarudza uri pakati pe 60 ne 88 here?
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Kufunga kwangu kuti zvakawanda sei zvemasikweya 28 akafukidzwa zvishoma zviri mukati medenderedzwa kwakanyorwa sechikonzero here?
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Zvinoratidzika kuti wakanyora uchiziva kuti mutengo chaiwo hauzivikanwi here?
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.model.0: 74 cm² inovimbika. Kumasikweya 60 ari mukati chaimo, kana ndikafunga kuti masikweya 14, hafu yemasikweya 28 akafukidzwa zvishoma, ari mukatiwo, i 60 + 14 = 74. Haisi mutengo chaiwo, uye ndinofunga ichanyatsorurama kana masikweya akapatsanurwa kuita madiki.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.model.1: Ndakasarudza 78 cm². Mukati merange hombe kupfuura 60 uye diki kupfuura 88, ndinofunga kuti zvinopfuura hafu zvemasikweya akafukidzwa zvishoma zviri mukati medenderedzwa, saka ndinofunga kuti mutengo wakarurama i hombe zvishoma kupfuura pakati, 74.
z-m-14-09.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Wakasarudza mutengo hombe zvishoma kupfuura pakati.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.prompt: Waverenga denderedzwa rimwechete zvakare pamapepa e grid apo sikweya imwe neimwe i 0.5 cm × 0.5 cm (nzvimbo 0.25 cm²). Pane masikweya 276 ari mukati chaimo uye masikweya 344 ari zvishoma kana kupfuura mukati. Kuchinjwa kuita nzvimbo, i 69 cm² ne 86 cm². Uchitarisa mhedzisiro itsva iyi, mhedzisiro yekutanga, nefungidziro dzandakanyora pamwe chete, kutonga kwakakodzera zvikuru i kupi?
z-m-14-09.s.s3.hint.0: Maka range yekutanga nerange itsva panumber line uye utarise kana dzichiwirirana.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa imwe neimwe kuti fungidziro dzandakanyora dzinowira mukati merange itsva here.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.o.a: Nzvimbo yedenderedzwa i hombe kupfuura 69 cm² uye i diki kupfuura 86 cm². Range yakaita diki.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.r.a: Waenzanisa mhedzisiro itsva neyekutanga kuti uone kana dzichipokana, uye wakaiverenga sekuti range yakaita diki.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.o.b: Range yakachinja kubva pamhedzisiro yekutanga, saka kwaiva nekukanganisa pakuverenga kwekutanga.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.r.b: Wakaona kuchinja kwerange sekukanganisa. Tanga watarisa kana ma range maviri achiwirirana.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.o.c: Masikweya akaitwa hafu yehukuru, saka zvino tinogona kuziva nzvimbo chaiyo yedenderedzwa.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.r.c: Range yakangoita diki; haina kuva mutengo chaiwo. Pachine masikweya akafukidzwa zvishoma.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.o.d: 77.5 cm², pakati perange itsva 69 kusvika 86, i nzvimbo chaiyo yedenderedzwa.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.r.d: Wakasimbisa kuti pakati perange i mutengo chaiwo.
z-m-14-09.s.s3.explain: Mhedzisiro itsva, 69 kusvika 86, iri mukati memhedzisiro yekutanga, 60 kusvika 88, uye range i diki. Kana ukapatsanura masikweya kuita madiki, range inoramba ichiita diki. Kana fungidziro yandakanyora yaiva kunze kwe 69 kusvika 86 (semuenzaniso, 65), inosefwa nemhedzisiro itsva, saka ndinongofanira kuigadzirisa.

z-m-14-12.title: Kureba kwetambo inosunga makani matatu
z-m-14-12.goal: Fungidzira kureba kwetambo inopoteredza ichibata makani nekuipatsanura kuita zvikamu zvakatwasuka nezvikamu zvakatenderera, uye uenzanise kuti kureba kwetambo kunochinja sei zvichienderana nemaronga.
z-m-14-12.material: Mira makani 3 ane chimiro chesirinda ane dhayamita ye6 cm ndokuasunga netambo imwe yakadhonzwa yakasimba kamwe kupoteredza pakati pekureba kwemakani. Tambo inobata mativi emakani pasina mikaha, uye usafunga nezvetambo inoshandiswa pakusunga. Verenga pi se3.14. Pane nzira mbiri dzekuisa makani. (가) Mira makani matatu padivi nedivi mumutsara, achibatana. (나) Mira makani matatu muchimiro chetriangle kuti ose abatane.
z-m-14-12.thinking.0: Kufunga perimeter yechimiro nekuchipatsanura kuita zvikamu
z-m-14-12.s.s1.prompt: Usati waverenga kureba kwetambo inodiwa kana uchisunga ne(가) uye ne(나), fungidzira kutanga. Ndeipi inoita seyakareba?
z-m-14-12.s.s1.hint.0: Dhirowa madenderedzwa matatu achionekwa kubva pamusoro uye udhirowe mutsara unotevera nzira yetambo.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.hint.1: Maka mapoinzi apo tambo inochinja kubva pachikamu chakatenderera kuenda kuchikamu chakatwasuka uye uverenge kuti pane zvikamu zvakatwasuka zvingani.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.o.a: (나) yakareba. Inokotama mativi matatu, saka tambo inopfuura nezvikamu zvakatenderera zvakawanda.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti kukotama kwakawanda kunoita kuti ireba. Ishande nekuwedzera kureba kwapo tambo inopfuura nezvikamu zvakatenderera.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.o.b: Nzira mbiri dzakafanana. Chero nzira, inopoteredza makani 3 ose.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.r.b: Wakasiya kuona kuti tambo haipoteredzi makani zvachose; pakati pemakani anobatana, inoenda ichitwasuka isingateereri muganhu.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.o.c: (가) yakareba. Chikamu chinoenda chakatwasuka pakati pemakani chakareba mu(가).
z-m-14-12.s.s1.r.c: Wakapatsanura tambo kuita zvikamu zvakatenderera nezvikamu zvakatwasuka ndokuenzanisa zvikamu zvakatwasuka zvemaronga maviri.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.o.d: Hatigoni kuenzanisa kusvikira tazivako kureba kwemakani.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.r.d: Kureba kwerwendo rumwe rwetambo kunosarudzwa nemaronga anoonekwa kubva pamusoro. Funga kana kureba kuchichinja kureba kwetambo.
z-m-14-12.s.s1.explain: Tambo inogona kupatsanurwa kuita zvikamu zvakatenderera zvemakani nezvikamu zvakatwasuka pakati pemakani. Mumaronga ose maviri, zvikamu zvakatenderera pamwe chete zvinoita denderedzwa rekani rimwe, uye chikamu chakatwasuka chakareba mu(가). Saka (가) inoita seyakareba. Unogona kuongorora kufungidzira uku nekuverenga.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.prompt: Hansol akawana kureba kwetambo yekusunga ne(가) sepazasi. Sarudza mutsara mumwe usina kururama.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.hint.0: Fungidzira mutsara unobatanidza nzvimbo dzepakati dzemakani ari kumagumo maviri uye uverenge kuti ndedhayamita ingani kureba.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.hint.1: Ongorora kana kani riri pakati richichinja kureba kwezvikamu zvakatwasuka.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.line.0: Nzvimbo dzinobatwa netambo dzinogona kupatsanurwa kuita zvikamu zvakatenderera zvemakani ari kumagumo maviri nezvikamu zvakatwasuka zvepamusoro nepazasi.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.line.1: Kubatanidza zvikamu zvakatenderera zvemakani ari kumagumo maviri kunopa denderedzwa rekani rimwe, 6×3.14=18.84 cm.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.line.2: Chikamu chakatwasuka chepamusoro chine makani 3 padivi nedivi, saka kureba kwacho i6 cm. Pazasi pane 6 cm futi.
z-m-14-12.s.s2.explain: Mutsara 3 hauna kururama. Chikamu chakatwasuka chepamusoro chakaenzana nehurefu pakati penzvimbo dzepakati dzemakani ari kumagumo maviri, saka nemakani 3 mumutsara i2 dhayamita, 12 cm. Pazasi pane 12 cm futi, saka 18.84+12+12=42.84 cm yakarurama, uye 30.84 cm yemutsara 4 haina kururama sechigumisiro.
z-m-14-12.s.s3.prompt: Wana kureba kwetambo kana uchisunga ne(나), uienzanise nekureba kana uchisunga ne(가) (42.84 cm), uye unyore kuti ndeipi pfupi uye pfupi sei, nechikonzero.
z-m-14-12.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora kuti chimiro chipi chaunowana kana ukabatanidza nzvimbo dzepakati dzemakani matatu e(나) uye kuti divi rimwe rakareba sei.
z-m-14-12.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora huwandu hwezvikamu zvakatwasuka nehuwandu hwezvikamu zvakatenderera zvakaparadzana uye uenzanise.

z-m-14-12.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora uchiziva here kuti nei zvikamu zvakatenderera zvakareba zvakaenzana mumaronga maviri?
z-m-14-12.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakaenzanisa here kuti kufungidzira kwako kwekutanga (danho 1) nemugumisiro wakaverengwa zvakafanana?

z-m-14-12.s.s3.model.1: Zvikamu zvakatwasuka mumutsara zvikamu 2 ze12 cm rimwe nerimwe, 24 cm, asi mutriangle zvikamu 3 ze6 cm rimwe nerimwe, 18 cm, saka triangle i6 cm pfupi. Zvikamu zvakatenderera pamwe chete mune zvose zvinoita denderedzwa rekani rimwe, 18.84 cm, saka zvakaenzana.
